description: İnşaat Aşamasındaki Yol Çalışmaları is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Yol Bakım ve Altyapı Koordinasyon Dairesi Başkanlığı. Bu veri kümesi ilçe bazında yapım süreci devam eden yol çalışmaları bilgilerini içerir. Coverage: Yol Bakım ve Altyapı Koordinasyon Dairesi Başkanlığı. The publisher named on the listing is Yol Bakım ve Altyapı Koordinasyon Dairesi Başkanlığı. Its keywords include inşaat, kavşak, yol. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2026-04-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
